name: E-commerce product pages
about: Product pages that Shopping ads and rich results depend on. Change the pages globs to your shop's product URLs.

rules.title: Product pages with no Product structured data
rules.fix: Add Product markup in JSON-LD with name, image and offers (price and availability), so the page can show price and stock in search.

rules.title: Product pages not shared as products
rules.fix: Set <meta property="og:type" content="product">, so social shares show the product card.

rules.title: Product pages that ask not to be indexed
rules.fix: Remove the noindex: a product page that can't be indexed gets no organic traffic and weakens Shopping ads' landing page checks.
